activityRevision.description: 支柱活动当前修订号。重开活动后旧 peer 的写入会被拒绝。

content.description: Markdown body for non-pillar documents. For pillar prefer `contract`; if content is used it must be IR JSON or a pillar-interaction-contract fence, not author prose. Host renders the author-facing document. Per-call pillar payload must stay <=32000 characters; the schema cap is deliberately higher so the Host can answer an oversize pillar with actionable compression guidance instead of a bare schema error.

contract.description: Pillar IR v4. Creative surface for pillar. May contain a subset of skeleton beats; Host merges by beat id and renders author markdown. Omit carrier and settlement prose. Do not put this JSON in content.

name.description: Display name in the asset manifest.

slug.description: ASCII filename slug prefix for docs/<slug>_<type>.md. For pillar reuse pillarSource.documentSlug. Chinese or other non-ASCII slugs are rejected.
